title: Taking a Journey reads clean: the right rail folds, heading buttons are one row, week titles are not doubled, the course page has its cover

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-17: "Check all the journey page headers. Clean it up." and "Whenever anyone is in Journey mode as a user, minimize the right rail."

detail: Journey mode (/journeys/<slug>/learn, play, guide, welcome) folds the right rail to its micro strip on arrival; the chevron opens it for that page only and the member's stored rail choice is untouched. kit-members.css `.head>div` (a column, for the title stack) out-ranked `.row`, stacking every header action; `.head>div.row` restores the row. phaseHeading no longer prefixes a label the title already leads with. The course page draws the cover band the Journey page already had.

verify.note: Fails on main: no Journey mode, stacked heading actions, doubled week titles, no cover on the course page.
